narrative.headline: Japan weather and seasonal travel evidence with explicit dates, freshness and coverage.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve Japanese places, inspect bounded forecasts and seasonal evidence, and compare caller criteria. Public first-party access without a paid account.
narrative.auth_narrative: Selected public products need no credentials. Member-only products and commercial WxTech are outside scope.
narrative.when_to_use: Resolve Japan weather places, inspect hourly/daily forecast horizons, and check sakura/foliage evidence or compare caller thresholds.

recipes.title: Compact seasonal search
